prompts.units:
Create an ORIGINAL production sprite sheet for Theandril, a gritty dark-fantasy hex strategy game about hearthland communities after the fall of the Witness Roads.
Exact sheet layout: 4 columns by 3 rows of equal square cells, no gutters, on a genuinely transparent background. Each cell is a 64 by 64 logical-pixel canvas shown at identical integer enlargement. Total logical sheet 256 x 192. Every figure fully contained inside its cell with generous transparent margins, feet on the same baseline at logical y=56, centered x=32. Orthographic three-quarter front view facing southeast, slightly seen from above, NOT isometric floor bases. No labels, grid lines, ground patches, shadows outside silhouette, text or watermarks.
Row 1: SAME Oathguard in four genuinely different restrained idle breathing frames: weathered charcoal iron helmet, narrow eye slit, brown padded coat, bone-colored scarf, sturdy boots, short worn sword down in right hand and small angular buckler in left. Stocky adult human realistic proportions, NOT chibi; no horns or copied game character.
Row 2: SAME Wayfinder scout in four restrained idle breathing frames: hooded olive wool cloak, leather bracers, travel pack, bow held diagonally, arrow quiver, face partly shadowed, lean adult human.
Row 3: SAME Hearthcaravan in four idle frames: weathered small two-wheeled handcart with covered ash canvas, crates, old brass oath bell, and one hooded adult traveler walking beside it. Clear wagon/traveler silhouette, not a horse or knight.
Visual style: authentic carefully hand-placed 64px pixel art, crisp square pixel clusters, hard edges, NO anti-aliasing, NO smooth gradients, NO blur, NO painterly texture, NO tiny dithering confetti. About 12-18 shared colors per row. Restrained charcoal/umber/oxidized iron/old bone palette with readable warm highlights. Northwest key light, dark but readable medium value bodies; serious worn fantasy craftsmanship. Animation registration and equipment identical throughout each row; only cloth/breathing posture subtle motion, feet remain planted. Make the whole sheet exact and useful as runtime game sprites, not a concept illustration.
prompts.objects:
Generate an original game production sprite sheet for THEANDRIL: 3 columns x 2 rows, exactly six equal square cells. True transparent background, no text, borders, grid lines, watermarks, floor tiles or ground bases. Every asset centered within its own cell and fully isolated with 12 percent transparent margin, nothing crossing cells. Same oblique top-down three-quarter strategic-map camera, roof planes visible, north-west light. Actual crisp pixel art with deliberately placed hard square clusters, no smooth illustration, no antialias, no blurry fake pixel filter. Each cell designed at native 96x96 pixels; sheet logical 288x192, may be enlarged by integer nearest-neighbor. Muted old stone, brown timbers, faded ash canvas, rust iron, straw, small warm hearth lights. Gritty serious adult dark fantasy original architecture, no borrowed game designs. Detailed but readable large value shapes.
Exact cells left to right:
TOP ROW: 1 a poor hearthland VILLAGE, three small steep-roof timber cottages around an oath stone and rough wooden fence; 2 a TOWN, compact five-store cluster of weathered stone/timber buildings, slate roofs, bell house and central kiln, clearly bigger architectural density; 3 a FORTIFIED CITY, crenellated compact stone enclosure, gate and four squat towers sheltering slate-roof town and a taller hearth hall, no cathedral copied from a game.
BOTTOM ROW: 1 ancient Witness Road RUIN, a broken freestanding arched waystation of dark stone with weathered vow tablets, rubble and sparse dead grass; 2 isolated weathered stone WATCHTOWER, square battered tower with wood porch and ash-colored banner, distinct silhouette; 3 a mineral RESOURCE DEPOSIT, jagged low iron-rich rocks, streaks of oxidized orange, compact excavation with two worn timbers, no cart.
Strong silhouette edges. Transparent pixels around and between all six objects. No continuous landscape, scene, labels or people. Consistent shared palette and pixel scale, restrained cluster-based shading.
prompts.terrain:
Original THEANDRIL terrain spritesheet, 4 columns by 3 rows of exactly equal square cells, all cells aligned. Each cell contains ONE pointy-top hex terrain tile, 64 by64 logical-pixel canvas with hex vertices (32,0),(60,16),(60,48),(32,64),(4,48),(4,16), no extrusion or bevel, no thick outline. Full flat hex top surface, orthographic top-down strategic map view. Transparent outside each hex; no other background, shadows, text, grid, labels. North-west lighting for raised trees/rocks. All tiles equally sized. Gritty original dark fantasy pixel-art craftsmanship; genuine small deliberate hard square pixel clusters, 8-12 colors per tile, restrained muted palette, no smoothing, no painterly grain, no micro-noise, no floating diorama bases. Broad readable ground value, clustered details, leave edge terrain simple for adjoining neighbors.
Exact left-to-right row order:
ROW1: temperate green grassland with sparse ochre grass tufts; dense dark temperate broadleaf forest canopy with visible earth; dark blue-green evergreen taiga with sparse snow; pale cold tundra with dry low scrub and stones.
ROW2: warm ochre desert low sand ripples; dry yellow-brown steppe with sparse pale bunchgrass; dark muddy marsh with shallow pools and reeds; dense deep green rainforest large broadleaf crowns.
ROW3: alpine gray rocky mountain mass with restrained pale snowcap; deep dark blue open ocean with short muted wave clusters; low stony brown green hills with visible ridges; shallow teal coastal water meeting a small worn sand spit on upper side.
Natural readable low-frequency shapes. Tile art should be beautiful at actual64pixel size. No rivers or roads painted across unrelated land, no buildings, no characters. Clearly distinguish the twelve terrain silhouettes/materials while matching one palette and perspective.
